plugin.name: flames
plugin._long: Animated flames rising from the bottom edge of the screen, drawn over all windows until toggled off. The desktop stays usable.

option.name: toggle
option._long: Starts the flames; they keep burning until the binding is used again. Also available as the IPC method flames/toggle.

option.name: height
option._long: Height of the flame zone in percent of the screen height.

option.name: intensity
option._long: Brightness and density of the flames in percent.

option.name: flip
option._long: Draw the flames from the other edge; only needed if they appear at the top of the screen.
